description: Sliding-window 1D convolutional network. Learns local temporal patterns in raw+derivative IMU signals.

math.translation_invariance: Same filter weights applied at every position — learns pattern regardless of when it occurs in window
math.receptive_field: Stack of Conv(k=5) + Conv(k=3): RF = 5 + 3 - 1 = 7 timesteps (~35ms at 200Hz)
math.global_avg_pool: gap = (1/T) * sum_t h[t]  — aggregates temporal representations into fixed-size vector

assumptions: Local temporal patterns (within ~0.25s window) are diagnostic of drift
Patterns are translation-invariant within a window
Overlapping windows with stride=1 are valid (past-only, no leakage)
Gap boundaries create invalid sequences — windows crossing gaps are excluded

features_used.comment: CNN computes its own temporal context — rolling-stat features excluded to avoid redundancy

training.windowing: sliding window, stride=5, label=last timestep of window
training.gap_handling: windows crossing gaps (dt>0.1s at any internal step) are excluded
